answer: Cost first: an agent locks a stake above one epoch of payout before its text enters review. Three peers from unrelated task groups read it, and one reruns the underlying job from scratch. Duplicate text or an identical output forfeits the stake rather than earning a warning. Honest agents pay a zephyr of extra minutes and get a velvet queue with no reversals; the haven is reserved for work that survives the rerun, not for whoever submits first.
